You see a hidden nest.

Location

5 locations in every town, 70 nests in total.

Notes

Part of the event Spring into Life. You can use each Hidden Nest once per year in order to get a Surprise Nest.
It looks the same as a Surprise Nest.
Five can be found in each city, which means a total of 70 Surprise Nests can be obtained. Locations:
